inspection.reviewer: Codex browser_recon + product_recon; recovery: Codex browser_recon
inspection.reviewMethod: 146 final PNGs individually inspected with view_image; 52 inherited only after exact SHA-256 equality to the preserved reviewed PNGs. Recovery extension: 1 freshly inspected and 23 inherited only after exact SHA-256 equality to actually reviewed PNGs.
fixesApplied: October 1 S112 release note is visible and readable on the current status page and generated release archive; existing S112 theme corrections remain intact.
Prior S112 recovery rendering retained under final source; 23 exact PNG matches plus one fresh inspection.
limitations: Synthetic states prove rendering, not gameplay semantics.
Byte equality carries prior pixel inspection, not prior source authority.
Automated contrast samples do not cover every application pixel.
Exact-byte inheritance carries only prior actual pixel inspection, never source/artifact authority.
Synthetic simulation notices prove rendering only; job behavior is separately tested.
Recovery simulation notices are synthetic rendering states, not evidence that background jobs execute correctly.
Populated and synthetic fixture captures prove rendering only.
Moment share captures cover the share control, not an exported image.
Public stats frames retain the actual loading/unavailable presentation; no service availability is inferred.
Exact PNG equality carries historical pixel inspection only; every current capture comes from f8b640/dc8f.
